items.label: Extra-long Leather Sofa
items.value: Measuring 84"W x 33"D x 30"H, this extra-long faux leather sofa comfortably seats 3 adults. With a 71" usable length, it doubles as a sofa bed, perfect for stretching out—even for someone 6 ft tall.

items.label: Premium Faux Leather
items.value: Crafted from high-quality faux leather, this couch offers a smooth, skin-friendly feel and upscale look. It's also a breeze to maintain—just wipe clean with a damp cloth. Built to last and look better with age.

items.label: Mid-Century Modern Charm
items.value: Designed with classic button-tufted cushions, square arms, and a sleek rectangular frame, this sofa brings timeless mid-century modern style to any living space. A perfect balance of elegance and comfort.

items.label: Comfort and Durability
items.value: Filled with thick D25 high-density foam and resilient springs, the seat and back provide lasting comfort. Supported by a sturdy frame and strong metal legs, this sofa holds up to 600 lbs with ease.

items.label: Easy and Efficient Assembly
items.value: Comes with clear instructions and labeled parts for fast, tool-free assembly. Note: The sofa ships in 2 boxes which may arrive separately. Please wait for all to arrive before full setup.
